svg.title: The Holy Earth Foundation. Plants & Miracles.
svg.desc: A forest before dawn breathing slowly into the light: a golden halo, and the Vine of the Soul, a twin-stranded liana of sky and gold with paired leaves and small pink-white flowers, rising toward it. I am one Self, united with my Creator.
